title: Declared action capabilities conservatively cover inferred effects
statement: Every catalogued action MUST declare a per-domain capability set that contains every statically inferred in-program effect; every subprocess template and in-program edge MUST be classified or explicitly dispositioned; every host mutation MUST pass through its Article-6 path-domain capability module. A capability is necessary and never sufficient: it grants no role, action, target, policy, consent, or readiness authority.
rationale: Fail-closed declared-versus-inferred containment prevents an action from reaching effects outside its reviewed contract, while domain-specific runtime assertions prevent a declared capability from crossing Article 6 boundaries. Keeping capabilities subordinate to the final authority adapter prevents effect metadata from becoming authority.

strategy.rationale: The declared static analyzer deterministically evaluates this invariant against repository structure.
